dedupe_keys.name: 3d opensees models of urm infilled rc frame buildings

description: 3D OpenSees Models of URM Infilled RC Frame Buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Zeeshan Manzoor Bhat, Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (iitr.ac.in). This repository contains OpenSees scripts for nonlinear three-dimensional models of reinforced concrete frames, both with and without infills. Two different types of infills are used: Fly ash brick masonry and AAC block masonry. A total of ten archetype buildings, comprising G+4 and G+7 stories with various configurations, are modeled. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: OpenSees, Masonry Infilled Reinforced Concrete Frames, Seismic Assessment. Published 2024-07-28. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
